candidateSearch.why: Candidates are derived from the closure, its ports, the canonical detour corridor and the interior of the circuit that detour encloses - not from a buffer around the clicked link. The crossing that causes the Greendale result is 2.8 km away and ON the canonical route, while the one beside the closure changes nothing.
candidateSearch.ifTruncated: When truncated is true the search was bounded before it finished, so 'no sensitivity found' does NOT mean the answer is robust.
